cohort: Singleton pregnant women visiting a tertiary centre in Iraq for delivery over a 3 year period.
finding: Iraqi women with pre-eclampsia had significantly higher gestational weight gain, rates of caesarean section, preterm delivery and low birth weight.
mod_finding: Caesarean section rates were higher in women with pre-eclampsia.
gest_age: Not stated but lower in the pre-eclampsia group
